description: This Java class implements a strategy for retrieving a feature property from a Thing object within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It handles the RetrieveFeatureProperty command, extracting feature details and returning the property value or errors if not found.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturePropertyStrategy
classes.description: Implements a command strategy to retrieve a specific feature property from a Thing, handling command execution, feature extraction, and result creation.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the retrieval process for a feature property based on the command, returning a result with the property or an error.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Extracts the specified feature from the Thing object.

methods.name: getRetrieveFeaturePropertyResult
methods.description: Creates a result containing the feature property value or an error if not found.

methods.name: getRetrieveFeaturePropertyResult
methods.description: Creates a result with the feature property value from a JsonObject.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the previous entity tag for the command, if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the next entity tag based on the current state of the Thing.
